title: KNOWING THE WAY BACK
passages: I still got anxious. Still got frustrated. Still felt myself pulled away from the person I wanted to be. By September, I could describe a process for returning: quiet, movement, making, time outside, reflection.

Sailing kept offering its own version of the lesson. Learn where effort helps. Learn where surrender helps. I couldn't command the wind or the tide, but I could keep learning to move with them. Then came a softer realization: I was following myself and discovering love already present in the life I was living.

reflections.prompt: What helps you find your way back?

Try one item from your return-to-self list. Notice what it offers you today.
